description: Source code for the HadoopConfDriverFeatureStep class, which manages mounting Hadoop configuration (via ConfigMap or local directory) onto Spark driver pods in Kubernetes.

classes.name: HadoopConfDriverFeatureStep
classes.description: Manages mounting Hadoop configuration into Kubernetes Spark driver pods, either via ConfigMap or local directory.

methods.name: configurePod
methods.description: Transforms the SparkPod to include Hadoop configuration volume and mount if Hadoop conf is specified.

methods.name: getAdditionalPodSystemProperties
methods.description: Returns additional system properties related to Hadoop ConfigMap name if Hadoop conf is configured.

methods.name: getAdditionalKubernetesResources
methods.description: Creates and returns Kubernetes ConfigMap resource if local Hadoop configuration directory is used.
